# Focus Train — Pomodoro study timer and train journeys across Japan

> Focus Train is a mobile Pomodoro and focus timer for iPhone, iPad, and Android. Choose a route in Japan, set the timer, and watch your train advance while you study or work. Explore solo or share a focus session in a multiplayer carriage, depending on your platform and app version.

Focus Train is free to download and offers in-app purchases. Completed journeys can unlock cities, postcards, and stamps. The travel journal shows focus streaks and time spent by region.

## Official website and app listings

- [Focus Train in English](https://focus-train.fr/): default product overview, download links, features, and common questions.
- [Focus Train en français](https://focus-train.fr/fr/): présentation et téléchargement en français.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id6789511554): official iPhone and iPad listing, Apple app ID 6789511554.
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.focustrain.android): official Android listing, package com.focustrain.android.
